snippet.title: Independent Games   《Rising snake:The present world》DEMO
snippet.description: 《Rising Snake》 is a semi sandbox horror decryption adventure game. A fictional university campus based on real size. A "Taoist" with special abilities. A twisted and bizarre story. Waiting for your arrival.
